dog.description_text: Meet Cookie — New Arrival! Cookie just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far from her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQCld29pky2eTr3ycGE6-OZZAT_VJHhk7IJ3Hu8y3pWPVtg?e=tLCBOP Cookie is a 6 year old female. She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Her foster says "Cookie was a little shy at first and loves hiding under blankets, but she warmed up so quickly to me and absolutely loves attention. She’s loves her beauty sleep during the day, and as soon as the sun sets she immediately finds you for head rubs. She purrs a lot and makes biscuits often and loves rubbing against your hand or hard objects and enjoys getting brushed. Cookie is the sweetest and easiest cat ever. She is so affectionate and comfortable when interacting with people. She loves to find my lap or rub against me when I’m not paying attention to her. She also loves to just sit at stare at me." If you’re open to a little patience and a lot of possibility, come meet Cookie! You might be the person who helps them feel safe, confident, and right at home. Check back for updates—or stop by to say hello and discover who Cookie is becoming.
dog.name: Cookie
